factory.name: Kanban.create
factory.signature: Kanban.create(host: HTMLElement, options: KanbanOptions): Kanban; moveKanbanCard(cards, id, to: KanbanTarget): KanbanCard[]; positionOf(cards, id, lanes: boolean): KanbanPosition | null; cellCards(cards, columnId, laneId): KanbanCard[]; columnCounts(cards): Map<string, number>

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the board (role=group); the toolbar is named '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

options.name: columns
options.description: Columns in display order: { id (unique), label, wipLimit? (1..10000 cards across swimlanes), collapsed? (initial), locked? (no cards move into or out of it) }. At least one. Replacing it clears the undo history.

options.name: lanes
options.description: Swimlanes (rows): { id, label, collapsed? }. With lanes every card needs a laneId.

options.name: cards
options.description: Cards: { id (unique), columnId, laneId? (required with lanes), title, description?, tags? (chips), color? (1..8 accent stripe), locked? }. The order within a cell is the array order. Validated (KANBAN_OPTIONS). Replacing it clears the undo history and aborts pending saves.

options.name: editable
options.description: Cards (and columns) can be moved. false hides the toolbar, grips, and column handles; arrow-key navigation and Enter still work.

options.name: columnReorder
options.description: Show column handles for reordering columns (when editable).

options.name: renderCard
options.description: Card content ({ column, lane, doc }). Return non-interactive content: the card is the focusable list item and its text is read by screen readers. Default: title, description, tags.

options.name: canMove
options.description: Veto a move (keyboard moves skip refused columns; pointer drops show an invalid target). Locked cards and columns, and full columns under wipPolicy 'block', are always refused.

options.name: moveCard
options.description: Save a move after it was applied. While it runs the card is aria-busy and cannot move again. A rejection or a timeout (requestTimeoutMs) moves the card back, removes the move from the history, announces the failure, and emits aui-move-error.

options.name: wipPolicy
options.description: 'warn' marks columns over their limit ('Over limit' text and icon); 'block' also refuses moves into a column at its limit (moves within the column stay possible).

options.name: virtualThreshold
options.description: Cells with more cards than this (20..100000) scroll on their own and render only the cards in view (measured heights, spacers, aria-setsize/aria-posinset).

options.name: headingLevel
options.description: aria-level of column and swimlane headings (2..6).

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Columns in the current order; collapsed reflects the board.

properties.name: canUndo
properties.description: A move or column reorder can be undone.

properties.name: canRedo
properties.description: An undone change can be redone.

properties.name: pending
properties.description: Ids of cards whose move is being saved.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; new cards or columns clear the history.

methods.name: positionOf
methods.description: Column, swimlane (null without swimlanes), and index of a card.

methods.name: moveCard
methods.description: Move a card (index defaults to the end of the cell). Goes through the same checks, event, save, and history as a user move; false when refused or cancelled.

methods.name: moveColumn
methods.description: Move a column in the column order (undoable, emits aui-column-move).

methods.name: setCollapsed
methods.signature: setCollapsed(kind: 'column' | 'lane', id: string, collapsed: boolean): void
methods.description: Collapse or expand a column or swimlane (emits aui-collapse-change).

methods.name: focusCard
methods.description: Focus a card, expanding its column and swimlane and scrolling a virtual cell to it.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo the last move or column reorder (saved through moveCard with reason 'undo'). Refused while saves are pending.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort pending saves, remove listeners and the rendered board.

events.name: aui-card-activate
events.description: Enter on a card, or a click (outside a single-pointer move).

events.name: aui-card-move
events.detail: { reason: 'move' | 'undo' | 'redo'; id: string; card: KanbanCard; from: KanbanPosition; to: KanbanPosition; cards: KanbanCard[] }
events.description: Before a move is applied; preventDefault() keeps the card where it was.

events.name: aui-move-error
events.detail: { id: string; reason: KanbanMoveReason; error: unknown }
events.description: moveCard rejected or timed out; the card is back where it was.

events.name: aui-column-move
events.detail: { reason: KanbanMoveReason; id: string; from: number; to: number; order: string[] }
events.description: Before a column reorder is applied; preventDefault() keeps the order.

events.name: aui-collapse-change
events.description: A column or swimlane was collapsed or expanded.

cssClasses.name: aui-kanban | --editable | --lanes | --picking
cssClasses.description: Host and modifiers; --aui-kanban-column-width, --aui-kanban-collapsed-width, --aui-kanban-list-height size the board.
